items.question: tbms
items.answer:
TBMS most commonly refers to the **Trojan Business Management System** or **E-Tendering Portal** used by Trojan Holding in the UAE, but it can also stand for a **Taxi Base Management System** or a **Translation Business Management System**.[](https://tbms.ae/Procurement/NewSuppData.aspx) [[1]](https://tbms.ae/Procurement/NewSuppData.aspx)[[2]](https://www.appbrain.com/app/tbms/ae.trojan.TBMS)[[3]](https://tbmslive.com/)[[4]](https://awtomated.com/faq/what-is-the-translation-business-management-system-tbms/)

Common Meanings of TBMS

- **Trojan Holding Portal:** An internal corporate and vendor e-tendering platform utilized in the UAE (accessible via the TBMS Supplier Portal).[](https://tbms.ae/Procurement/NewSuppData.aspx) 
- **Taxi Base Management:** Cloud software used by transport and chauffeur fleets to handle bookings and dispatching (TBMS Dispatch Software).
- **Translation Business:** Administrative software used by language agencies to manage invoices, clients, and projects (Awtomated TBMS FAQ).

items.question: etisalat business
items.answer:
Etisalat (now operating as e& UAE) provides comprehensive telecommunication, internet, and digital solutions for small, medium, and large enterprises through the [e& UAE Business Portal](https://www.eand.ae/en/smb/business-online-portal.html).

### Key Business Services & Plans

- **Mobile Plans:** [Business First Plus](https://www.eand.ae/en/smb/products/mobile/mobile-plans/business-first-plus.html) mobile packages start from AED 88 per month, featuring local/international minutes, roaming data add-ons, and Careem Plus subscriptions.[](https://www.eand.ae/en/smb/index.html) [[1]](https://www.eand.ae/en/smb/index.html)[[2]](https://www.eand.ae/en/smb/products/mobile/mobile-plans/business-first-plus.html)[[3]](https://www.eand.ae/en/smb/smb-offers.html)
- **Internet & AI Solutions:** High-speed Business Pro AI and internet solutions bundle connectivity with cloud PABX, security firewalls, and domain tools.[](https://www.eand.ae/en/smb/products/fixed-services/business-internet.html) [[1]](https://www.eand.ae/en/smb/products/fixed-services/business-internet.html)
- **Account Management:** You can monitor usage, track orders, and settle invoices directly via the [Etisalat Business Online](https://businessonline.etisalat.ae/) portal.[](https://www.eand.ae/en/smb/business-online-portal.html) [[1]](https://www.eand.ae/en/smb/business-online-portal.html)[[2]](https://businessonline.etisalat.ae/)
- **Support:** Reach the 24-hour small business helpline at **800 5800**.[](https://support.etisalat.ae/en/business/small_business.jsp) [[1]](https://support.etisalat.ae/en/business/small_business.jsp)

If you'd like, let me know:

- Are you looking for **mobile plans**, **broadband/internet** , or **cloud applications**?
- What is the **size of your company**?

I can help you find the exact plan or contact details you need.

items.question: aed dirham symbol
items.answer:
![UAE unveils new symbol for its dirham currency – Middle East ...](https://api.dataforseo.com/llm_m/cdn/i/7290321513420689639:7403b33f589cd4aac42e1896ddcc38c2)
The official currency of the United Arab Emirates uses the modern symbol (a capital letter 'D' crossed with two horizontal lines) introduced by the Central Bank of the UAE . Traditional and common text abbreviations include **AED**, **د.إ** in Arabic, and informal variants like **Dh** or **Dhs**.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Arab_Emirates_dirham) [[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Arab_Emirates_dirham)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emirati_dirham_sign)[[3]](https://wise.com/gb/currency-converter/currencies/aed-united-arab-emirates-dirham)

Official and Common Symbols

- **New Graphic Symbol:** A capital "D" with two horizontal lines inspired by the UAE flag, representing national strength and progress.
- **Arabic Abbreviation:** **د.إ** (derived from Dirham and Emarati).
- **Latin Abbreviations:** **AED** (official ISO code), along with legacy short forms **Dh** and **Dhs**.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Arab_Emirates_dirham) [[1]](https://tallysolutions.com/mena/business-guides/new-uae-dirham-symbol-business-impact/)

Usage Guidelines

- **Placement:** The symbol always appears to the left of the numerical value with a small space (e.g., 50).
- **Digital & Physical:** It is widely implemented across price tags, digital banking apps, invoices, and financial platforms.
- **Subunit:** 1 dirham equals 100 fils.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Arab_Emirates_dirham) [[1]](https://www.facebook.com/CentralBankUAE/videos/centralbankuae-issues-the-guidelines-for-the-national-currency-symbol-uae-dirham/4220111028309266/)[[2]](https://www.centralbank.ae/en/our-operations/currency-and-coins/)
